_comment: Minimum test coverage per component, in percent (R41, docs/43-coverage-reporting.md).
The component's OWN CI job enforces its floor, so a shortfall is reported by the
job that owns the code. Floors are set from a measured baseline rounded down to
the whole percent and then dropped by one, so that a single nondeterministic test
cannot red the tree; raise one in the PR that earns it. Lowering a floor is
allowed but needs its reason in the commit body.
null means 'measured and published, not yet gated' — the escape hatch for a
component whose baseline has not been established.
